q: What does it do on GitHub?
a: It writes files only. Branch protection, merge settings, labels and secrets are yours to change, so it lists the commands instead. On a private repository CodeQL needs the paid GitHub Code Security, so it asks first.
npx skills update updates the skill. upgrade then compares what it generated, hash by hash, with the new templates, and writes only the files you have not edited.

q: What stops an agent working on main?
a: The rules tell it to check the branch before its first edit and to branch without asking. Git refuses a commit on main and a push to it. GitHub branch protection, which you enable, is the final rule.
